start: Attendance page, signed in as owner; the register has been used for some weeks

steps.action: Open Attendance
user_sees: 'Who trained, and when', the box 'Check someone in', the tiles 'Check-ins today' ('So far today') and 'Check-ins a day' ('Average over the last N days')
must_not: Money figures on this page
Yesterday counted as today

steps.action: Type a name or the last 4 digits of a mobile, tap 'Check in'
user_sees: The button shows 'Saving…', then a message, and the member is on top of today's register
'Check-ins today' goes up by one
must_not: Two check-ins for one tap
The check-in saved on another day

steps.action: Tap 'Losing the habit' (the number beside it is the count)
user_sees: 'Paying members who are losing the habit'; three counts (Not settled in, Slipping, Gone quiet) and a card per member, most urgent first
A card reads like '16 days since their last visit. They usually train every 2 days.' with a pill 'Slipping' and 'Usually 6 am–7 am'
must_not: A member whose plan has ended, or ends within the renewals window, on this list
A reason that talks about money
A member who came today or yesterday listed

steps.action: Tap a member's name
user_sees: That member's page opens
must_not: Another member opens

start: Attendance page, signed in as owner

steps.action: Type a name nobody has
user_sees: 'Nobody matches that' and 'Check the spelling, or add them in Members first.'
must_not: A blank list with no words
A check-in saved for nobody

steps.action: Pick tomorrow in 'Register date'
user_sees: 'That day hasn’t happened yet.'; the check-in box is replaced by 'Pick a day first' / 'Pick a day that has already passed. Then the check-in box comes back.'
must_not: A check-in saved on a future day

steps.action: Open 'Losing the habit' in a gym that has checked in on fewer than 5 days
user_sees: 'Start checking members in' and 'This list needs a few days of check-ins first. Check members in as they arrive, and it fills in by itself. Nobody is listed just because their visits were never added.' with 'Open the register'
must_not: Every member listed as gone
'Everybody is training' shown when the register was never used

steps.action: The save of a check-in fails
user_sees: The server's words, or 'That didn’t work. Please try again.'
must_not: A success message
The row left in the register

start: Attendance page, signed in as owner; a member was just checked in by mistake

steps.action: In today's register tap the undo control ('Undo check-in for <name>')
user_sees: A message 'Check-in removed for <name>.'; the row is gone and 'Check-ins today' is one lower
must_not: The count stays
Another member's check-in removed

steps.action: Check the same member in again
user_sees: One row for today
must_not: Two rows for one day

steps.action: A member on the 'Losing the habit' list is checked in today; open the list
user_sees: That member has left the list
must_not: The member is still listed as away

steps.action: A member on the list gets a plan that ends within the renewals window, or the plan ends
user_sees: The member leaves this list (the renewals list has them)
must_not: The same member on both lists with two different asks

steps.action: Every member with a running plan comes as usual
user_sees: 'Everybody is training' and 'Every member with a running plan is coming as usual.' with 'Back to the register'
must_not: An empty page with no words

start: Attendance page, signed in as owner; the second way in: the figures and the chart of the last weeks

steps.action: Look at the tiles
user_sees: 'Check-ins a day' as the average over the trend days, empty days counted; when it is under one a day the tile says 'Check-ins a week' (or 'Under 1')
must_not: An average that leaves closed days out
NaN or a figure with many decimals

steps.action: Look at 'When the gym is busy'
user_sees: The 24 hours in order, with the busiest hour named as a span like 6 am–7 am
With no believable times: 'No timed check-ins yet' / 'Each check-in here saves the time. This fills in as you use the register.'
must_not: Imported check-ins with no real time counted in an hour
A busiest hour shown when there is none

steps.action: Pick an earlier day in the register date
user_sees: 'Check-ins on <day>' / 'On that day' and that day's rows; a row from the member app carries the tag 'App', from a paper import 'Imported', from an entry machine 'Machine'
A day with none: 'No check-ins on this day.'
must_not: Today's rows shown under another day
A member who was deleted hidden instead of shown as 'Unknown member'

start: Attendance, 'Losing the habit', signed in as owner; another kind of row and the file

steps.action: Look at a member who joined 12 days ago and never came
user_sees: 'Joined 12 days ago and hasn’t trained yet.' with the pill 'Not settled in'
must_not: 'Has never checked in.' for a brand new member of 2 days
A pass member (from a pass company) on the list

steps.action: Pick the group 'Gone quiet' in 'Filter by what is happening'
user_sees: Only those cards; an empty group says 'Nobody in this group'
must_not: Counts on the chips that do not match the cards

steps.action: Tap the export button
user_sees: A CSV with the columns Member, Mobile, Batch, Status, Last visit, Days since visit, Visits in last 8 weeks, Why; a message 'Exported N members.' ('Exported 1 member.' for one)
must_not: Rows in the file that are not on screen
A mobile number changed by the spreadsheet (lost zero or exponent form)

start: Attendance, 'Losing the habit', signed in as owner

steps.action: Read the cards
user_sees: Only names, the reason in days, the usual hour and the batch
must_not: Fees due, plan price or any money word in a reason
A member of another branch

steps.action: Tap the export button
user_sees: A file with the names and mobile numbers of exactly the rows on screen
must_not: Archived members in the file
Members the filter hid
